db_subject: Cationicity Enhancement on the Hydrophilic Face of Ctriporin Significantly Reduces Its Hemolytic Activity and Improves the Antimicrobial Activity against Antibiotic-Resistant ESKAPE Pathogens
db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (73.68%) to Ctriporin K: 37%, I=L: 16%. Activity: active against S. aureus ATCC29213 or ATCC25923 MRSA (MIC 1.8 uM), E. faecium ATCC29212 (MIC 3.5 uM), E. coli ATCC25922 or ATCC35218 (MIC 1.8-3.5 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC27853 (MIC 1.8 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC700603 (MIC 3.5 uM), A. baumannii ATCC19606 (MIC 0.9 uM). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: HC50> 500 ug/ml. 20% hemolysis at 500 ug/ml, poor hemo.lytic. MOA:bacteria:A. baumannii: membrane permeation. Structure: random coil in water and helical in 30 mM SDS micelles.
